historical_references.reference: Hema was an ancient Hindu goddess of fertility and love. Some believe she was an early form of Parvati, the consort of Shiva.
Hema was also the name of a renowned queen of the Sindh kingdom, who ruled from 335 to 317 BCE and is known for her military campaigns and diplomacy with Alexander the Great.

On Instagram, Hema is a popular name for fashion and beauty influencers, showcasing traditional Indian attire and makeup trends.
